newsitem.title: USA: GE Capital unit to expand in Virginia.
newsitem.headline: GE Capital unit to expand in Virginia.

text.p: GE Capital Services Co.'s Consumer Savings and Insurance Group said Friday it planned to set up a corporate headquarters in Richmond, Va.
GE Capital is a wholly owned subsidiary of General Electric Co.
The Consumer Savings and Insurance Group (CSIG) was set up in December 1996 and had been temporarily based in Stamford, Conn., GE Capital spokeswoman Mary Horne told Reuters.
She said the relocation investment would be about $15 million, and that the move involved no loss of jobs or transfers from Connecticut.
In a related move, the CSIG also said it would expand its existing operations in both Richmond and Lynchburg, Va.
The CSIG's business includes the operations of Life of Virginia and First Colony Life Insurance as well as other consumer insurance operations of GE Capital Services.
The decision will create 350 jobs, of which 200 will be in Richmond and 150 in Lynchburg, Horne said.
Some of those positions will come from CSIG's Seattle operations, which are being downsized, Horne said.
Horne said the process would take about 18 months.
GE Capital Services, with assets of more than $225 billion, is a global, diversified financial services company with 27 specialized businesses.
